advisories: Optional — wrap range: overlap aliases every ~0.1-0.16 px. Ampcor azimuth is measured in stage_coregister and explicitly not applied (TOPS policy); pre-alignment is geometry + range Ampcor only, so the 'geometry+Ampcor residual well under ~0.05 px' assumption is unstated and can fail. Coherence >= 0.85 does not void wraps (a 0.12 px residual wraps to ~-0.03 px with high coherence and small per-overlap scatter). Disclosed wrap is accepted; the false coherence-as-unwrap mitigation is not. Do not add Ampcor-az apply. Pin synthetic tests to include a near-wrap and a beyond-wrap shift that must not be reported as a small in-wrap value. A split-band coarse unwrap is Optional, not MVP-required (ISCE2 NESD has the same wrap).

Optional — R_A vs R_B: FanInSAR measure_misreg resamples secondary onto the pair-primary grid, so delta_A is ~0 and R_B = d phi_DD / d delta_B is exact. |R_A-R_B|/|R_B| is diagnostic only and will not catch a shared coordinate bug (see crop-origin blocker). Do not silently switch to ISCE2's dual-resample-onto-stack-reference grid without revisiting the divisor (that reopens PR 28139 mean-of-two-dates). Do not implement f_top/f_bot as Doppler-centroid polynomials alone; f is instantaneous azimuth frequency from the full TOPSCarrierModel (steering K_t*(eta-eta_ref)+f_dc), else R is ~100x too small.
Optional — do not form overlap IFGs from stitch_bursts(..., overlap_blend=True) output; blending destroys the dual-burst carrier the DD needs. Overlap windows are per-burst, not stitched.

Optional — AC-3 sigma: weighted scatter is undefined for one qualifying overlap and 0.0 would trip invert_pair_misregistration (sigma must be finite and positive). Pin a sigma floor. Current measure_misreg dummy sigma (0.05 if |az|>1e-9 else 1.0) and n_valid=1 must not survive for overlap arcs.
Optional — persist the resolved method (overlap|splitband) on MisregArc, not the config literal 'auto'. Verification plan asks arcs to carry expected method.
Out of Scope — per-burst azimuth corrections, NISAR overlap windows, new Torch/Dask contracts, wrapping ISCE2 overlap_withDEM.py, changing invert algebra.
